# Database diagram

Schema after applying every migration up to and including **00032_farm_owner_credentials**.

Generated by `services/api/cmd/dbdiagram` from a scratch Postgres with all of
`services/api/migrations` applied, so it shows what the database really is,
not what someone remembered to draw. Any pull request that adds a migration
must include this file regenerated (`make db-diagram`); the `api` CI job
checks it. The narrative design lives in [modelo-datos.md](modelo-datos.md).

Legend: `PK` primary key, `FK` foreign key, `UK` unique. A quoted note after a
column gives the exact Postgres type when the diagram had to shorten it, and
`null` when the column accepts NULL. Relations point from the referenced table
to the table holding the foreign key; the label is the foreign-key column
(references inside a farm are composite with `farm_id`, which the label omits).
